room_rent.note: Base plan has no sub-limit on room/boarding. Optional Cover 8 can restrict to Single Private Room for a discount.

icu.note: Policy explicitly states no separate restriction on ICU charges.

copayment.display: None (base); 20% if Smart Select opted and non-network hospital used
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional Cover 6 allows voluntary co-pay for premium discount. Optional Cover 4 (Smart Select) imposes 20% co-pay for non-network hospitals.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure sub-limits stated in base policy wording.

deductible.note: Deductible is Optional Cover 3; not applicable in base plan.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Reducible to 24 months via Optional Cover 5 (paid add-on).

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, ENT surgeries, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a permanent exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Base NCB: 10% per claim-free year, max 50%. Optional Cover 1 (NCB Super) adds 50%/yr up to 100% additional, totalling up to 150% combined — only if add-on opted.

restoration.note: Automatic Recharge reinstates base SI once per year after full exhaustion; usable for same or different illness. Unlimited recharge available via Optional Cover 11.

pre_hosp.note: Extendable via Optional Cover 13 (Pre-Post Hospitalisation Expenses Modification).

day_care.note: Annexure I lists 541 day-care procedures across specialties.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered under standard definition when patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured at registered AYUSH hospitals; subject to same waiting periods.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor's harvesting surgery expenses covered up to SI; post-harvesting expenses excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered; exact rupee limit specified in policy schedule, not in wording. Air ambulance available as Optional Cover 2.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed advance technology methods covered under Benefit 1 including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.

consumables.note: Annexure II lists non-medical/consumable items as excluded (gloves, nebuliser kit, etc.). No rider available to cover them.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no look-back except fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium mode.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, hormone replacement therapy, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, external congenital anomaly, hair loss, external prosthetics, non-listed advance tech methods

optional_riders.display: NCB Super (100% bonus), Air Ambulance, Deductible, Smart Select, PED wait reduction (24mo), Co-pay option, Health Check-up, Room Rent cap, Daily Allowance, Accidental SI top-up, Unlimited Recharge, E-Consultations, Pre-Post hosp extension
